customer_updates.name: Gaurav Tayade
customer_updates.text:
K. Rustom & Co. is not just an ice cream parlour — it’s a slice of Mumbai’s history, nostalgia, and sweetness served between two wafer biscuits. Located right opposite Marine Drive, this humble little shop has been delighting generations of Mumbaikars long before fancy dessert chains took over the city. Walking into K. Rustom’s feels like stepping back in time, where simplicity, tradition, and genuine flavor still matter.
The moment you enter, you’re greeted by a display filled with colorful ice cream sandwiches stacked neatly in their signature paper wraps. There’s no loud décor, neon lights, or Instagram aesthetic — and that’s exactly the charm of this place. It has retained its old-world authenticity over the decades, focusing purely on what truly matters: great taste and generous portions at affordable prices.
The menu may look simple, but every flavor carries its own personality. From classic favorites like strawberry, vanilla, and chocolate to more unique ones like walnut crunch, rum and raisin, raspberry ripple, and kesar pista — each scoop has a distinct richness. The ice cream is perfectly firm, creamy yet light, and the wafer adds that satisfying crunch which makes every bite nostalgic.
One of my personal favorites is their Walnut Crunch — it’s rich, nutty, and has that perfect balance of sweetness without being overpowering. The Rum and Raisin flavor, too, stands out with its mature taste and smooth texture. Even their Mango and Pineapple flavors are fresh and fruity, reminding you of homemade ice creams made with love.
What makes K. Rustom’s truly special, though, is the experience that surrounds it. You grab your ice cream sandwich, step outside, and just a few steps away is the iconic Marine Drive promenade. Sitting by the sea, enjoying the breeze, and relishing that cold, creamy delight as waves crash nearby — it’s a feeling that no modern dessert café can replicate. It’s Mumbai in its purest form — simple joys in a chaotic city.
Another reason people love K. Rustom’s is their consistency. They’ve been serving quality ice creams for decades, and despite the growing popularity, they haven’t changed their style or pricing drastically. The service is quick, the staff polite, and everything runs with quiet efficiency — just like it always has.
If you’re visiting Mumbai or even if you’ve lived here all your life, K. Rustom & Co. deserves a spot on your must-visit list. It’s a reminder that some things never need to change to stay perfect.
In a world of gourmet desserts and Instagram cafés, K. Rustom’s remains refreshingly old-fashioned — and that’s exactly what makes it legendary. A scoop of nostalgia, a dash of heritage, and a lot of happiness — that’s what every visit feels like. ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Govind Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
K. Rustom & Co. is not just an ice cream parlour—it’s a timeless Mumbai experience that perfectly blends nostalgia, simplicity, and great taste. Located near Churchgate Station, opposite the Ambassador Hotel, this iconic spot has been serving its legendary ice cream sandwiches since 1953, and it truly lives up to its reputation.
The highlight here is undoubtedly their signature ice cream sandwiches—thick, creamy slabs of ice cream pressed between crisp wafer biscuits. The texture is rich and smooth, never icy, and the flavours are honest, balanced, and not overly sweet. We tried a variety of flavours including Walnut Crunch, Coffee, Kesar Pista, Pista, Vanilla, Choco Crunch, Candied Cream, and Chocolate Almond. Chocolate Almond and Walnut Crunch stood out as absolute favourites, while Coconut Pista felt slightly below average. Each flavour tasted true to its name, showcasing quality over gimmicks.
What makes K. Rustom & Co. special is its no-frills, old-world charm. There’s no fancy décor or seating—just a simple setup where people from all age groups patiently queue up for a taste of nostalgia. The service is quick and efficient, even during peak hours, though it can feel a bit rushed due to the crowd. The place is often busy, especially in the evenings and on weekends, which only proves its enduring popularity.
Prices are very reasonable considering the quality and legacy. Do note that the outlet accepts cash only, so it’s best to come prepared. There’s no parking, no photography allowed inside, and occasionally some flavours may be unavailable—but these minor inconveniences are easy to overlook once you take that first bite.
Overall, K. Rustom & Co. offers simple, authentic ice cream with a strong emotional connect. It’s perfect for a quick dessert after a walk at Marine Drive or for introducing visitors to a true taste of Mumbai’s culinary heritage. Not fancy, not modern—just classic, comforting, and memorable. A must-visit for every dessert lover in Mumbai. 🍨✨

featured_reviews.name: Merlin
featured_reviews.review_text: K. Rustom & Co. is one of Mumbai's most iconic old-school ice cream parlours, located near Churchgate. Established in 1953, it is best known for its signature ice cream sandwiches tucked between thin wafer biscuits. They offer classic flavors like vanilla and chocolate along with favorites such as mango, raspberry, and butterscotch each bite tasting nostalgic and timeless. featured_reviews.name: Tanmay Ayare
featured_reviews.review_text:
K. Rustom & Co. – A Mumbai Classic Ice Cream That Never Disappoints

Location - Near Churchgate Station, opposite Ambassador Hotel, Mumbai

Stepping into K. Rustom & Co. is like taking a trip back in time and every bite of their iconic ice cream sandwiches takes you even further. A true Mumbai institution, this old-school parlour continues to win hearts with its unique charm and legendary flavours.

What We Tried

We ate a delicious range of flavours:

- Walnut Crunch – nutty, creamy, and perfectly balanced

- Coffee – subtle, strong, and not overly sweet

- Candied Cream – fun, nostalgic. Kids would love it

- Pista – smooth and mildly flavoured

- Choco Crunch – rich chocolate with bits of crunch that added great texture

- Paan – surprisingly refreshing with just the right hit of paan essence

All of them were served between their signature thin wafer biscuits, making it easy to eat (and very photogenic!). The texture is dense yet smooth, and each flavour felt true to its name.

Price & Experience

Prices are very affordable, especially considering how unique and satisfying the product is. Do note: it’s cash-only and no seating, but that’s part of the charm.

Service is quick and straightforward. You queue up, pick your flavour, pay, and step outside most likely with a smile.

Verdict

K. Rustom & Co. is not just an ice cream parlour, it's a Mumbai experience.
If you're near Marine Drive or Churchgate, make this a stop. Perfect for a post-walk treat or to introduce visitors to a taste of Mumbai's legacy.

After a fabulous lunch , I went to this place . I had heard good things about this place . So decided to explore , dessert is the thing that gives you happiness . Summer season going on , so i was excited to try out the new menu .

“SHAHI DURBAR “ is the place to have desserts and some quick bites . It is a small outlet located at Carter road. Being a kulfi fan , this place is must to visit . Different types in sundaes , kulfi and some signature milkshakes make this place attractive.

The ambience is Simple but decorative,but the place is too small .
Service was also good , as the staff was friendly .

WHAT I HAD

1)SHAHI DURBAR SPECIAL PIZZA - So recently they have added pizza and pasta in the menu . the pizza tasted delicious, melting mozzarella cheese tasted amazing. It was topped with olives , the views impact was huge .

2)PENNE PASTA IN COCKTAIL SAUCE - Penne pasta in a cocktail sauce, cocktail sauce is combination of both red and white sauce . It was perfectly cooked. It tasted pretty good . It tasted a bit sweet

3)MANGO SUNDAE - Summer season going on , This mango sundae has 3 things . Mango ice cream along with mango kulfi slices , topped with mango fruit . Flavourful taste with classic presentation. Would recommend it .

4)BLUEBERRY AND STRAWBERRY MILKSHAKE- A proper thick milkshake having fresh taste of both the fruits . Perfectly thick with perfect amount of sweetness.

5)BELGIUM CHOCOLATE GALETO - A Belgium chocolate stick dipped in a Nutella sauce , was topped with choco chips . It had rich chocolate flavour , tasted amazing. Over all heaven for chocolate lovers .

6)COCONUT GALETO - Another Classic galeto dipped in a Nutella sauce, topped with pista and almond . Creamy coconut rich taste at the best . The coconut and Nutella combination went well .

7)SHAHI DURBAR SPECIAL FALOODA - “AMAZING”! Don’t have other word to describe this . Falooda noodles along with basil and different flavours of kulfi . The base was flavourful, overall it tasted amazing. The quantity was also sufficient. Definitely worth to have it .

On the whole it was classic experience. Though it is small place but still Loved the variety of desserts , I would surely recommend this place .

Looking forward to my next visit .

Recommend 5/5

Keep traveling, keep eating, keep Clicking.

Yesterday after a spicy heavy lunch we were craving for some droolworthy desserts so me along with my friends bumped in to this icecream parlour nearby to try out some of their singnature desserts they are well known for!
So Basically this outlet is located at a 5 mins walking distance from Versova rock beach at 7 Bunglows. You can get here from Andheri station by bus( 251 ) as well as auto.

4. HOT FUDGE BROWNIE- It was basically a brownie with chocolate topping along with colourfull srpinkles. Brownies should be served super hot but I found this one a less warmer which made it taste a bit dry .
Overall it was a good decision to try this outlet. And yes I would surely recommend this outlet for once a try specially the sundae they serve. Also they serve tender coconut and guava icecream which is well known.

featured_reviews.name: Aakash Makwana
featured_reviews.review_text:
10 January 2020- 20.00 hours
"All-Natural ice-creams"

This is not the first time I visited TIB (The Ice-cream Bakery). I have been here numerous times since its inception. I wish I had all the pictures of all the times I have been here. I would have had hundreds of pictures. I love this place so much so that when I am around, I go nowhere but to TIB for desserts. They are a small outlet located at the Versova junction and served phenomenal desserts.

The staff is super talented and quick. At our most recent visit we were attended by Manager - Satish and the support staff were Bharat and Nitish. The support staff were super quick the manager had a solid grasp over the skills needed to decorate the desserts and cakes. Most of the presentation you will see in the pictures are done by him. Some of the items you should try here are Chocolate Ice-creams, Ice Cream Strawberry, Milky Way, Dark Chocolate Ice Cream & Brownie.

Desserts

Let's discuss all that we had at TIB. The first one that we tried is called NEWYORKERS. It is called so because it is made by squashing the New York cheesecake along with the secret mixture which is milk like in appearance. Here they take  a piece of cheesecake and mix it with the milk like mixture and blend it into a scoop of this super soft and cheesy ice-cream. It is must try for the cheesecake lovers.

Another one is called a type of shooter which is their term for multi-layered ice-cream mousse. The dessert was called - GLOSSY CHOCOLATE SHOOTER. Here you get a multi-layered ice-cream mouse which involves layers of liquidy chocolate ice-cream, dark chocolate ganache and powdered brownie. The layers looked and tasted scrumptious.

Addition to the taste, the way Bharat was setting up the layers was fascinating. The liquidy chocolate was so chocolaty that you feel like you are having a melted cold chocolate. Next up was a sundae called DARK NIGHT SUNDAE. Satish almost completely prepared this. This sundae is served in a Martini glass and includes two dark chocolate scoops, Nutella biscuit powder, Butterscotch crunch, Oreo biscuit powder, Bourbon biscuit, Chocolate sticks and whip cream.

Are you tired of reading the ingredients of the Sundae? Let me tell you I have not mentioned the rainbow sprinkles and chocolate sauce added to the dessert at the end. It is a wholesome dessert and made to be shared and so we did. All the contents were added perfectly and decorated beautifully. You should give it a try to see how good of a sundae it is. It is absolutely worth the price.

After having so much of chocolate we wanted to have something fruity and what better than Strawberry in this season could satisfy our cravings? We ordered strawberry in scoop; it was made live as they do for almost everything. The taste was perfectly berriesh. The conclusion was extremely satisfying. The only recommendation could be to make the ambiance and seating a little organized. Rest all is perfect.

featured_reviews.name: Craig Saliyan
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you love ice-cream , then The Icecream Bakery (TIB) is your dream  destination . they have many outlets I visited this one in Mulund. the ambience is quite elegant. TIB makes their own ice-cream. They do not use any kind of artificial flavours. The ice cream that you order is prepared in front of you . It's really a pleasant experience to eat ice cream over here and it must be tried. TIB has a plethora of options to soothen your soul . Unique flavours , ice cream shooters, ice cream cakes , milkshakes , sundaes , you name it they have it all . I tried the following :
-> Rose Gulkand icecream: Gulkand for those who don't know is a mixture of rose petals and sugar. It tastes wonderful. This ice cream was simply lipsmacking . It's a part of the "Royal Indian Flavours" . The flavour of the gulkand  was clearly evident . Also since they prepare the ice cream right in front of you , you can see them adding the gulkand . The flavour of rose seemed extremely natural and fresh. Do give it a shot if you love gulkand .
-> Newyorkers: This is a part of their "TIB Mashups" . So what exactly is a mashup you may ask . It is basically cakes mashed up with their ice cream base. Newyorkers is a cheesecake mashup. This ice cream is straight up heavenly. The combination of the cheesecake and the ice- cream is a match made in heaven. Comin to TIB and not trying this ice cream would be a sin.
-> Mocha-Mocha Shooter : A shooter is a multilayered ice-cream mousse. It consists of layers brownie crumbs , semi-solid chocolate and coffee ice cream. Topped with a layer a whipped cream the mocha-mocha shooter is perfection. The flavours of the chocolate , brownie crumbs, coffee icecream  binds really well . The flavours are really well balanced.
-> Dark Night Sundae : first of all this dish had a presentation that was just next level awesome . The taste is a heavenly ride. The dark chocolate was well combined with the other elements of this dish .

At TIB you don't just eat your ice cream , you see it being prepared in front of you which in my opinion just sweetens the experience.
